svg.title: Multi-Robot Collaborative Assembly — System Overview
svg.desc: Three-column functional overview of task preparation, perception and control, and a robot team with one localization robot and two assembly robots. Dashed gold paths show a limited learning exploration, separate from the localization-guided final construction approach.

g.text: ONE LOCALIZATION ROBOT + TWO ASSEMBLY ROBOTS
